mapper.sql: SELECT t.tag_id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, t.description AS description, NULL AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN t.tag_name IN ('条件退', '不可退') THEN IFNULL(auto_stat.project_count, 0) ELSE IFNULL(rel_stat.project_count, 0) END AS projectCount, IFNULL(rel_stat.project_count, 0) AS manualProjectCount, CASE WHEN t.tag_name IN ('条件退', '不可退') THEN IFNULL(auto_stat.project_count, 0) ELSE 0 END AS automaticProjectCount, CASE WHEN t.tag_name IN ('条件退', '不可退') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS systemRefundTag FROM service_tag t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.tag_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.project_id) AS project_count FROM project_service_tag_rel r JOIN service_tag rt ON rt.tag_id = r.tag_id WHERE rt.tag_name NOT IN ('条件退', '不可退') GROUP BY r.tag_id ) rel_stat ON rel_stat.tag_id = t.tag_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.tag_name, COUNT(DISTINCT x.project_id) AS project_count FROM ( SELECT rr.project_id, '条件退' AS tag_name FROM refund_rule rr WHERE rr.refund_type = 'CONDITIONAL_REFUND' UNION ALL SELECT rr.project_id, '不可退' AS tag_name FROM refund_rule rr WHERE rr.refund_type = 'NO_REFUND' ) x GROUP BY x.tag_name ) auto_stat ON auto_stat.tag_name = t.tag_name
